name: Shenzhen Infinova Limited
summary: Shenzhen Infinova Limited provides electronic security products and solutions China and internationally. It offers thermal and explosion proof cameras, network cameras, control room, encoders and decoders, recorder, network video management software, and fiber optics transmission device, as well as camera accessories. The company was formerly known as Kuantuo Technology (Shenzhen) Ltd. and changed its name to Shenzhen Infinova Limited in December 2007. Shenzhen Infinova Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
